Playbook.name: Oracle — Database Link Created by Unexpected Principal - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: An Oracle CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK was performed by an unexpected principal (INH_LIFE excluded). A database link connects to another database - it can be used to exfiltrate or pivot. Triage: unauthorised DB link (exfil/pivot), or legitimate integration?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A public database link can exfiltrate data to or pivot into another database - a data-movement and lateral-movement vector.

LogSources.LogSource: Oracle DB audit via apps-* - apps-*

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Oracle DB audit in apps-* (verified live). Fields: ACTION_NAME, USERNAME, SQL_TEXT, plus the audited object. Rules exclude known service principals (e.g. INH_LIFE, BANKSYS, JCB_AML). The acting principal is USERNAME.

Signal.Name: Database Link Created by Unexpected Prin
Signal.Details: Oracle ACTION_NAME CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK by an unexpected USERNAME.

Input.name: $username
Input.description: Oracle principal that performed the action (USERNAME).

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the Oracle CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK by an unexpected principal is malicious/unauthorised or legitimate DBA/application activity.

Step.name: Confirm the Oracle action, principal and SQL
Step.Purpose: The principal, the SQL text and the target object separate authorised DBA/app work from unauthorised access.
Step.Query: FROM apps-* | WHERE ACTION_NAME == "CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK" AND USERNAME == "$username" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, ACTION_NAME, USERNAME, SQL_TEXT | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: INH_LIFE is excluded, so this is an unexpected principal creating a DB link. Read SQL_TEXT for the target object and scope. An unexpected principal performing CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK on sensitive banking tables is the concern; a known DBA/app principal is likely authorised.

Step.name: The principal's broader Oracle activity
Step.Purpose: A burst of privileged actions by one principal indicates scripted abuse or a compromised DB account.
Step.Query: FROM apps-* | WHERE USERNAME == "$username" AND ACTION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS actions = COUNT(*), action_types = VALUES(ACTION_NAME) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Many privileged actions across objects by one principal = scripted/abnormal; a single expected action = routine.

Node.Condition: A public DB link to an external/unexpected database by an unrecognised principal.
Node.Result: True Positive (Unauthorised DB Link - escalate, DBA + IR)

Node.Condition: A known DBA/application principal performing the action as part of normal operation.
An application using an unexpected-but-legitimate service account (baseline gap).
Action by an unrecognised principal with unclear authorisation.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-ORA-ACTION, INV-02-ORA-BREADTH to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: A legitimate integration DB link by an approved account.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the principal/operation is authorised; add to the baseline; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: An unauthorised DB link for exfil/pivot.

SOCAction.Item: Investigate the principal and session; if unauthorised, disable the account and review data impact; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A legitimate app using an unbaselined service account.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the principal and target object; confirm authorisation.
If unauthorised, disable the account and review data impact.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Disable the account; review affected data/objects; open IR.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce least-privilege on DB principals; alert on privileged actions by new principals; review DBA access.

QualityChecks.Check: Rules exclude known service principals; the acting principal is USERNAME; SQL_TEXT gives the operation detail.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Account disabled; data impact reviewed; IR recorded.
